title: kramastotra — kram-p13-v13
question: Thisness-just Your form, O Lord, power-juiced — by sequencelessness itself forcibly melted is time-reckoning. By mind-power, by speech too, then by sense-wheels outside, then by pot and the rest — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
